source.name: Chief Marketer: Citigroup Gets Shea Naming Rights for $400 million
source.quote: As of 2009, the New York Mets will play in a ballpark called Citi Field, thanks to a $400 million deal between Citigroup and the National League team.

note: Arena naming rights: Citi Field. Start date unknown: the record said 2026 (the season it was recorded), its source is from 2006-11-14.
